title: USPS Mail Fell To 109 Billion Pieces
hook: USPS mail fell to 109 billion pieces.
closing: Fewer letters spread the postal network's costs across fewer customers, keeping postage under pressure.
question: What do you still mail?

segments.say: USPS mail fell to 109 billion pieces. The network now carries nearly half its former traffic.
USPS First-Class Mail fell to 46 billion pieces. Personal and business letters disappeared fastest.
A USPS stamp reached 68 cents. Shrinking volume did not make sending a letter cheaper.
